svg.aria-label: Eight bird shape types side by side, from a small round egg through a hatching bird to a grown bird with a full wingspan.
svg.title: From egg to full wingspan
svg.text: One frame from each bird shape type, in the order their widths grow: three characters wide, then four, up to seven.
A type's width comes from phoenix_bird_draw_entries; narrower shapes are centred here so the growth is easy to see.
drawn by draw_bird_shape_350c · 2 to 7 columns x 2 rows · background set
attract_mode.c: drawbirdobject() calls draw_bird_shape_350c(entry, hl, shape)
The egg is not a separate object with its own code: it is the same draw routine with fewer columns.
Widths are read from the table, not measured from the picture - the pointer stride between a type's frames is exactly two per column, which confirms it.
